top_signals.title: Yen Climbs Sharply After Warnings of More US-Japan Intervention
top_signals.summary: The yen rallied sharply on Monday after Japan and the US warned they were ready to wade into the market again after coordinated intervention last week that reversed more than two months of losses in the currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
